sn22.81:1.1: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Kosambiyaṃ viharati Ghositārāme || || 2
sn22.81:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavā pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaram ādāya Kosambim piṇḍāya pāvīsi ||
sn22.81:1.3: Kosambiyam piṇḍaya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapatikkanto sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikaṃ pakkāmi || || 3
sn22.81:2.1: Atha kho aññataro bhikkhu acirapakkantassa Bhagavato yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantam Ānandaṃ etad avoca || ||
sn22.81:2.2: Esāvuso Ānanda Bhagavā sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅgham eko cārikam pakkanto ti || || 4
sn22.81:2.3: Yasmiṃ āvuso samaye Bhagavā sāmaṃ senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya anāmantetvā upaṭṭhāke anapaloketvā bhikkhusaṅghaṃ eko adutiyo cārikam pakkāmi eko va Bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye viharitukāmo hoti
sn22.81:2.4: na Bhagavā tasmiṃ samaye kenaci anubandhitabbo hotīti || || 5
sn22.81:3.1: Atha kho Bhagavā anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Pārileyyakaṃ tad avasari ||
sn22.81:3.2: tatra sudam Bhagavā Pārileyyake viharati bhaddasālamūle || || 6
sn22.81:3.3: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yenāyasmā Ānando tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Ānandena saddhiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn22.81:3.4: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 7 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū āyasmantam Ānandam etad avocuṃ || || Cirassaṃ
sn22.81:3.5: sutā kho no āvuso Ānanda Bhagavato sammukhā dhammī kathā ||
sn22.81:3.6: icchāma mayaṃ āvuso Ānanda Bhagavato sammukhā dhammiṃ kathaṃ sotun ti || || 8
sn22.81:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando tehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ yena Pārileyyakaṃ bhaddhasālamūlaṃ yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || 9
sn22.81:4.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinne kho te bhikkhū Bhagavā dhammiyā kathāya sandassesi samādapesi samuttejesi sampahaṃsesi || || 10
sn22.81:4.3: Tena kho pana samayena aññatarassa bhikkhuno evam cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn22.81:4.4: Kathaṃ nu kho jānato katham passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti || || 11
sn22.81:4.5: Atha kho Bhagavā tassa bhikkhuno cetasā ceto parivitakkam aññāya bhikkhū āmantesi || ||
sn22.81:4.14: Evaṃ vicayaso kho desito bhikkhave mayā dhammo || || 12
sn22.81:4.15: Evam vicayaso desite kho bhikkhave mayā dhamme || atha panidhekaccassa bhikkhuno evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn22.81:4.16: Kathaṃ nu kho jānato katham passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hotīti || || 13
sn22.81:5.1: Kathaṃ ca bhikkhave jānato katham passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 14
sn22.81:5.2: Idha bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānam adassavī || la || sappurisadhamme avinīto
sn22.81:5.4: yā kho pana bhikkhave sā samanupassanā saṅkhāro so || ||
sn22.81:5.5: So pana saṅkhāro kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavoti || ||
sn22.81:5.6: Avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā ||
sn22.81:5.8: Iti kho bhikkhave so pi kho saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno ||
sn22.81:5.9: sā pi taṇhā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā ||
sn22.81:5.10: sā pi vedanā || so pi phasso anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno ||
sn22.81:5.11: sā pi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā || ||
sn22.81:5.12: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 17
sn22.81:6.1: Na heva kho rūpam attato samanupassati ||
sn22.81:6.2: api ca kho rūpavantam attānaṃ samanupassati ||
sn22.81:6.3: yā kho pana sā bhikkhave samanupassanā saṅkhāro so || ||
sn22.81:6.4: So pana saṅkhāro kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavo || ||
sn22.81:6.5: Avijjāsamphassajena bhikkhave vedayitena phuṭṭhassa assutavato puthujjanassa uppannā taṇhā ||
sn22.81:6.7: Iti kho bhikkhave so pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paticcasamuppanno ||
sn22.81:6.11: sā pi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā || ||
sn22.81:6.12: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 18

sn22.81:7.2: api ca kho attani rūpam samanupassati ||

sn22.81:7.11: sā pi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā || ||
sn22.81:7.12: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 19

sn22.81:8.2: api ca kho rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati || ||

sn22.81:8.4: So pana saṅkhāro kiṃnidāno kiṃsamudayo kiṃjātiko kimpabhavo || ||

sn22.81:8.12: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato || la || āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 20
sn22.81:9.1: Na heva kho rūpam attato samanupassati || na rūpavantam attānaṃ || na attani rūpam || na rūpasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati || || 21
sn22.81:9.2: Api ca kho vedanam attato samanupassati || api ca kho vedanāvantam attānaṃ samanupassati || api ca kho attani vedanaṃ samanupassati || api ca kho vedanāya attānaṃ samanupassati || || 22-23
sn22.81:9.4: Api ca kho saṅkhāre attato samanupassati || api ca kho saṅkhāravantam attānaṃ samanupassati || api ca kho attani saṅkhāre samanupassati || api ca kho saṅkhāresu attānaṃ samanupassati || || 24
sn22.81:9.5: Api ca kho viññāṇam attato samanupassati || api ca kho viññāṇavantaṃ attānaṃ || api ca kho attani viññāṇam || api ca kho viññāṇasmiṃ attānaṃ samanupassati || ||
sn22.81:9.6: Yā kho pana sā bhikkhave samanupassanā saṅkhāro so || ||
sn22.81:9.7: So pana saṅkhāro kiṃnidāno || la || kimpabhavo || ||

sn22.81:9.10: Iti kho bhikkhave so pi saṅkhāro anicco saṅkhato paṭiccasamuppanno ||
sn22.81:9.14: sā pi avijjā aniccā saṅkhatā paṭiccasamuppannā || ||
sn22.81:9.15: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 25

sn22.81:10.6: Api ca kho evam diṭṭhi hoti ||
sn22.81:10.7: so attā so loko || so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato avipariṇāmadhammo ti || ||
sn22.81:10.8: Yā kho pana sā bhikkhave sassatadiṭṭhi saṅkhāro so ||
sn22.81:10.10: Evam pi kho bhikkhave jānato evam passato anantarā āsavānaṃ khayo hoti || || 26

sn22.81:11.7: So attā so loko so pecca bhavissāmi nicco dhuvo sassato aviparināmadhammo ti || ||
sn22.81:11.8: Api ca kho evaṃ diṭṭhi hoti
